ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two terrain profiles in the figure. The direction label at the bottom of the left profile is “west—east”; point M is at a position slightly left of the baseline, and the mountain peak labeled ① is located east of point M. The direction label at the bottom of the right profile is “south—north”; point M is at a position slightly left of the baseline, and the mountain peak labeled ② is located north of point M. Then reason: Taking point M as the origin of a plane coordinate system, ① in the left figure indicates that the intersection point of this mountain range and the latitude profile through point M is east of point M; ② in the right figure indicates that the intersection point of the same mountain range and the meridian profile through point M is north of point M. If ① and ② belong to the same mountain range, then the mountain range axis roughly connects the “northern point” and the “eastern point,” and its extension direction is northwest—southeast.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左侧剖面是过M点的纬线方向剖面，底部标有“西—东”，①山峰位于M点以东；右侧剖面是过M点的经线方向剖面，底部标有“南—北”，②山峰位于M点以北。再推理：把M作为平面坐标原点，①对应同一山脉在M以东的纬线交点，②对应同一山脉在M以北的经线交点。若①、②为同一山脉上的两个位置，则连接“东侧点”和“北侧点”的山脉轴线，方向为西北—东南。

再推理：以M点为平面坐标原点，左图中①表示该山脉与过M点纬线剖面的交点在M点以东；右图中②表示同一山脉与过M点经线剖面的交点在M点以北。若①、②属于同一山脉，则山脉轴线大致连接“北侧点”和“东侧点”，其延伸方向为西北—东南。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the statement that the two sections are of equal length and are drawn along the meridian and parallel through M, and use the condition that ①、② belong to the same mountain range.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A mountain range’s走向 can be inferred by plotting two points on the same ridge in map view and drawing the line through them. A point east of M and a point north of M define a line slanting from northwest to southeast.
